Class GroveCompassProbe

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveCompassProbe
public final class GroveCompassProbe extends Object
Probes Seeed's Grove 3-Axis Digital Compass V2.0, which uses a BMM150, and reads its raw axes without allocating. The module must be plugged into one of the shield's I2C sockets, never a D socket. new GroveCompassProbe(i2c) probes through a given I2c instead of the board's, which is how a unit test mocks it.
